ontology.name: Microwave
ontology.description: Canonical functional diagnostic ontology for microwave ovens (countertop and over-the-range). Models functional relationships and diagnostic dependencies; magnetron, HV cascade hardware, waveguide parts, turntable motors, and per-TCO devices belong in platform overlays.
ontology.frozenNote: CG-MICROWAVE-FREEZE rev1 — LG + Samsung fit/discovery witness. 7 core components + 2 conditional concepts. Zero component promotion. Locked by CG_MICROWAVE_FREEZE_LOCK_v1.json.

designPrinciples: Model functional microwave generation, safety authorization, RF delivery, and thermal protection — not individual HV components or physical cavity hardware.
hv_generation describes generation/conditioning of electrical energy required for microwave generation — not magnetron, transformer, capacitor, diode, or fuse as canonical nodes.
rf_cavity is a functional energy-delivery/containment domain — not a synonym for the physical cavity enclosure.
Keep hv_generation and rf_cavity as separate canonical functions — causal chain control_board → hv_generation → rf_cavity captures diagnostic dependency without merging domains.
door_interlock_chain is an independent HV safety contract — distinct from generic door switches on other appliance families.
thermal_protection is one canonical protective network function — LG/Samsung TCO and thermistor topologies are platform overlay realizations.
CONDITIONAL concepts (control_and_sensing, ventilation_otr) require platform procedure evidence before graph participation.
Tests produce evidence; evidence changes component and hypothesis state (handled in procedure + intelligence layers).
Do not condemn downstream RF or HV paths until required upstream authorization and excitation conditions are established.
Unknown information must remain unknown — never infer good or bad without evidence.
Procedure branch logic and test definitions stay in service procedure seeds, not in this file.

ontologyContract.canonicalComponentRule: components[] lists only discovery-approved core functions — 7 nodes from CG-MICROWAVE-DISCOVERY closure.
ontologyContract.conditionalConceptRule: Evidence-backed functional roles not universally instantiated — encoded in conditionalConcepts[], not components[].
ontologyContract.implementationNotOntology: Magnetron, HV transformer/capacitor/diode/fuse, waveguide, turntable motor, humidity sensor, and individual TCOs are platform vocabulary — never canonical nodes.

semanticBoundaries.hv_generation: Generation/conditioning of electrical energy for microwave generation — not individual HV components.
semanticBoundaries.rf_cavity: Functional energy-delivery/containment domain — not synonym for physical cavity enclosure.
semanticBoundaries.hvRfSplit: Causal relationship does not authorize merge — failures can localize to either domain independently.

conditionalConcepts.freezeRationale: Humidity/cabinet/environmental sensing recurs on LG and Samsung sensor-cook paths but is not asserted universal to all microwave configurations.
OTR ventilation is configuration-specific — must not become canonical requirement for countertop/built-in microwave.

componentStateModel.description: Component verification states for this ontology. Distinct from intelligence-engine hypothesis ranking.
componentStateModel.engineSeparationNote: Diagnostic ranking, candidate support, and routing effects do not constitute component verification.

components.name: Control board
components.note: Orchestration node — HV relay enable and self-test paths; relay hardware names are platform overlay vocabulary.

components.name: Door interlock safety chain
components.note: Multi-switch HV safety contract — primary/secondary/monitor/door-sensing are platform vocabulary under this function.

components.name: High-voltage generation path
components.note: Generation/conditioning of electrical energy for microwave generation — not individual HV components.

components.name: RF energy delivery / containment
components.note: Functional energy-delivery/containment domain — not synonym for physical cavity enclosure.

components.name: Thermal protection network
components.note: Single protective thermal function — per-TCO devices and thermistors are platform overlay realizations.

relationships.note: HV enable gated by interlock monitor chain — distinct safety contract.
Relay-gated HV enable — implementation relays are platform vocabulary.
Thermal network can gate HV excitation — multi-node TCO topology is overlay scope.
Causal excitation path — domains remain independently diagnosable.

functionalDependencies.description: Control and HV loads require verified mains supply.
Control board responsive and able to command loads and read safety inputs.
HV paths require verified door interlock monitor chain.
High-voltage generation path must be authorized and thermally permitted before RF delivery diagnosis.
functionalDependencies.note: hv_generation is the canonical function — per-node HV component tests bind in platform overlay.

functionalDependencies.description: RF energy delivery requires excitation from hv_generation; failures can localize to RF/cavity path while HV behaves correctly.
functionalDependencies.note: rf_cavity is distinct from hv_generation — waveguide/turntable/arcing diagnostics bind here in overlay.

general.rule: Establish mains supply before condemning control or HV paths.
Establish door interlock chain before condemning HV generation.
Establish hv_generation path before condemning rf_cavity delivery — but recognize domains are independently diagnosable.
Do not merge hv_generation and rf_cavity — causal chain is not a merge authorization.
Magnetron, HV components, waveguide hardware, and individual TCOs are platform knowledge — never canonical nodes.
Do not instantiate control_and_sensing or ventilation_otr without platform overlay scope.
Negative or incomplete evidence should reduce candidate support without manufacturing verification.

diagnosticEntryPoints.note: Route HV component procedures to hv_generation overlay; waveguide/arcing/turntable to rf_cavity overlay.
Arcing/waveguide cover diagnostics bind to rf_cavity — not hv_generation merge.
